This makes a nice chewy cake with a strong matcha flavor. Replace the matcha power with high quality cocoa powder for a chocolate version.

For the right thickness use a 9 inch (23 cm) cake tin with removable bottom, lined with baking paper.

Ingredients

  • 100 g butter
  • 300 ml sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 150 ml plain flour
  • 50 ml matcha powder
  • 1 tsp vanilla sugar
  • 1/4 tsp salt

Instructions

  1. Pre heat the oven to 175 degrees C (350 F)
  2. Melt the butter and put aside
  3. Mix all ingredients expect the butter into a bowl
  4. Add the melted sugar to the rest of the ingredients and mix well
  5. Pour batter into cake tin
  6. Place in the middle of the oven for 25 minutes
